title: Computational Protein Stability Analysis of SCN1A Missense Variants Reveals Domain-Dependent Stability Patterns
description: Methodology and analysis code for a structure-guided protein-stability study of SCN1A (Nav1.1) missense variants. The pipeline combines FoldX 5.1 (RepairPDB + BuildModel) and Rosetta Cartesian ddG (ref2015_cart), with membrane-aware RosettaMP (franklin2019), applied to an AlphaFold3-predicted full-length Nav1.1 structure (UniProt P35498). Domain-stratified analysis distinguishes a proteostasis-impaired pore-region (P-loop / selectivity-filter) subset from a complementary, stability-neutral S4 voltage-sensor subset, and compares physics-based stability with sequence-based predictors (AlphaMissense, EVE). This archive contains the analysis scripts, the AlphaFold3 input structure, representative raw FoldX/Rosetta outputs, and a reproduction guide. The full per-variant dataset and publication figures are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.
